title: Mycelium RNA Extraction and Library Prep
author: Chidrupi Golla
materials: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the RNA pellets

Thaw the following reagents and spin down briefly using a microfuge, before mixing as indicated in the table below, and place on ice. RNaseOUT™ Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #10777019 Maxima H Minus Reverse Transcriptase Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog ##EP0741
In a separate tube, mix the following together: RNaseOUT™ Recombinant Ribonuclease Inhibitor Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #10777019
Add the 8 µL of strand-switching reagents (prepared in steps 6-7) to the 11 µL of snap-cooled mRNA (from steps 2-5). Mix by flicking the tube and spin down.
Thaw the following reagents and spin down briefly using a microfuge, before mixing as indicated in the table below, and place on ice.
Combine the following reagents in a 0.2 ml PCR tube:

steps.title: Initial Soil Sieve and Dispersion
steps.instruction: Sieve collected soil samples through a 2-mm sieve to remove root fragments. Disperse a 5 g soil sample into 100 mL of deionized water and stir at 500 rpm using a magnetic stirrer for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Coarse Particle Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the mixture through a 1000 µm pore nylon mesh. Wash the oversized particles with 100 mL of deionized water. Repeat the filtration and washing process with the filtrate.

steps.title: Fine Particle Filtration and Collection
steps.instruction: Filter the filtrate twice through a 50 µm pore metal sleeve containing a 50 µm pore nylon mesh. Discard the filtrate and collect the oversized particles in a 50 mL tube by rinsing them with 35 mL of deionized water (store at 4°C if needed).

steps.title: Sucrose Density Gradient Purification
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 00:03:00 at 31,000 x g. Disperse the pellet by adding 50 mL of 45.5% sucrose solution and shake vigorously by hand. Centrifuge the solution at 50 x g for 00:01:00. Filter the supernatant through a three-layered 50 µm pore size nylon mesh. Repeat this sequence (centrifugation, sucrose dispersion, and filtration) four more times.

steps.title: Particle Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Thoroughly wash the particles collected on the nylon mesh with deionized water to remove all sucrose solution. Collect particles into a 3 mL Eppendorf tube and allow them to dry completely (store between 20-30 °C if needed).

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Grind the dried particles into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen. Add 2 mL of TRIzol Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #15596026) and grind further until the slurry thaws. Split the sample into two 2 mL Eppendorf tubes and incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.

steps.title: RNA Phase Separation and Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of chloroform, shake vigorously for 15 seconds, and incubate at room temperature for 00:03:00. Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 00:15:00 at 4 °C. Repeat the chloroform addition and centrifugation steps. Precipitate the RNA using 500 µL of isopropanol at -20 °C for 02:00:00, then collect the precipitate by centrifugation at 13,000 x g for 00:15:00 at 4 °C.

steps.title: RNA Quantification and Preparation
steps.instruction: Quantify the RNA using Qubit and Nanodrop fluorometers. Prepare the RNA in nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription Setup
steps.instruction: Add 1 µg of total RNA to a 0.2 ml PCR tube and adjust the volume to 7.5 µL with nuclease-free water. Mix by flicking and spin down. Prepare the reaction (as per specified components), mix by flicking, and spin down.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 60 °C for 00:05:00, then snap cool on a pre-chilled freezer block for 00:01:00. Mix by flicking and spin down. Incubate at 42 °C for 00:02:00 in the thermal cycler. Add 1 µl of Maxima H Minus Reverse Transcriptase (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #EP0741) to reach a total volume of 20 µL. Mix by flicking and spin down. Follow the thermal cycler protocol.

steps.title: cDNA Cleanup and RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase Cocktail Enzyme Mix (ThermoFisher, cat # AM2286) to the reaction and incubate for 00:10:00 at 37 °C. Transfer the sample to a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube. Add 17 µL of resuspended AMPure XP beads (AXP), mix by flicking, and incubate on a Hula mixer for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Bead Washing and cDNA Elution
steps.instruction: Pellet beads on a magnet and remove supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL of fresh 80% ethanol in nuclease-free water. Remove residual ethanol and dry for ~00:00:30 (do not crack). Resuspend pellet in 20 µL nuclease-free water and incubate on a Hula mixer for 00:10:00. Pellet beads on a magnet for at least 00:01:00 and retain 20 µL of eluate in a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Secondary cDNA Purification
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction in a 0.2 ml thin-walled PCR tube and incubate. Transfer the sample to a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube. Add 40 µL of resuspended AMPure XP beads (AXP), mix by flicking, and incubate on a Hula mixer for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary Bead Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Pellet beads on a magnet and remove supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL of fresh 80% ethanol. Remove residual ethanol and dry for ~00:00:30. Resuspend pellet in 21 µL nuclease-free water and incubate on a Hula mixer for 00:10:00. Pellet beads on a magnet for at least 00:01:00 and retain 21 µL of eluate in a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: DNA Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNA using an Agilent Bioanalyzer and Qubit Fluorometer.

steps.title: End Repair and dA-Tailing
steps.instruction: Prepare NEBNext Ultra II End Repair / dA-tailing Module reagents on ice. Mix the reaction by pipetting and spin down. Incubate at 20 °C for 00:05:00 and 65 °C for 00:05:00 using a thermal cycler.

steps.title: End-Prep Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Transfer DNA to a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube. Add 60 µL of resuspended AMPure XP Beads (AXP), mix by flicking, and incubate on a Hula mixer for 00:05:00. Pellet on a magnet and remove supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL of fresh 80% ethanol. Dry for 00:00:30. Resuspend pellet in 61 µL nuclease-free water and incubate for 00:02:00 at room temperature. Pellet on a magnet for at least 00:01:00 and retain 61 µL of eluate in a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Repeated End-Prep Cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the End Repair/dA-Tailing incubation and the subsequent AMPure XP bead cleanup process two additional times (total of 3 cycles), following the same temperatures, timings, and volumes (60 µL beads, 61 µL elution).

steps.title: Ligation Preparation
steps.instruction: Spin down Ligation Adapter (LA) and Quick T4 Ligase and place on ice. Thaw Ligation Buffer (LNB) at room temperature, mix by pipetting (do not vortex), and place on ice. Thaw Elution Buffer (EB) and Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) at room temperature, vortex, spin down, and place on ice.

steps.title: Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Mix components in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube, pipetting 10-20 times between each addition. Mix by gently pipetting and spin down. Incubate for 00:10:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Ligation Cleanup and Library Elution
steps.instruction: Add 40 µl of resuspended AMPure XP Beads (AXP), mix by flicking, and incubate on a Hula mixer for 00:05:00. Pellet on a magnet and remove supernatant. Wash beads twice with 250 µL of Short Fragment Buffer (SFB). Remove residual supernatant and dry for ~00:00:30. Resuspend pellet in 15 µL Elution Buffer (EB), spin down, and incubate for 00:10:00 at room temperature. Pellet on a magnet for at least 00:01:00 and retain 15 µL of eluate in a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Final Library Quantification and Adjustment
steps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of the eluted sample using a Qubit fluorometer. Depending on fragment size, prepare the final library in 12 µL of Elution Buffer (EB).

steps.title: Sequencing Reagent Preparation
steps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SB), Library Beads (LIB) or Library Solution (LIS), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF) at room temperature, vortex, spin down, and store on ice. Prepare the flow cell priming mix with BSA by combining FCF and FCT and mixing by pipetting.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Open the MinION or GridION device lid and secure the flow cell. Open the priming port. Use a P1000 pipette set to 200 µL to draw back 20-30 µL of buffer to remove air bubbles. Load 800 µL of priming mix into the priming port and wait five minutes.

steps.title: Library Loading Preparation
steps.instruction: Mix Library Beads (LIB) by pipetting. In a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube, prepare the library for loading. Load an additional 200 µL of priming mix into the priming port. Mix the prepared library by pipetting just prior to loading.

steps.title: Library Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Lift the SpotON sample port cover. Add 75 μl of the prepared library to the flow cell via the SpotON sample port dropwise. Replace the SpotON cover and close the priming port. Place the light shield against the clip and lower it to cover the top section of the flow cell. Close the device lid and start the run on MinKNOW.
